A dignified middle-aged man around 50, lean upright build, restrained copper-brown hair with grey at temples, angular but believable anime face, calm closed mouth and cold controlled gaze; entirely human, no monstrous features. He wears a long near-black brown heavy ceremonial robe, old gold embroidered vertical trim and a modest dark metal sunburst pendant, severe high collar, muted wine lining glimpsed only inside sleeve. Refined and imposing through posture, not grotesque. Simple low headdress or bare head so face reads; do not copy the girl's flower, veil or female dress. One large full-body three-quarter standing figure on warm light-grey plain background, holding an unlit simple iron-and-wood torch downward away from body, both feet visible; a small supporting close portrait at upper right with the EXACT same face. Complete robe hem, natural hands, subtle candle-warm rim light, detailed fabric and metal, matching the reference's anime painterly finish. No real-person likeness, no text or character labels, no logos, no infographic panels, no watermark, no background scene, no victim, no flames, no gore.
